t07_common_validation_cohort.note: T08 reuses the accepted T07 FULL run's evidence read-only, after hash verification -- it is never recomputed. The common validation cohort itself is simply the frozen T05 validation partition, unchanged since T05.
t07_common_validation_cohort.reuse_scope: read-only reference to T07 FULL's tables/model_summary.csv (random/response rows) and hash-verified models/response_model.txt + development prediction parquets; the 200-draw random-ranking distribution and Response fit are never recomputed by T08

decision_record.question: What scale-gating path and SMOKE workload does T08's two-arm T-Learner fit need under D30, and what LightGBM configuration governs mu1/mu0?
evidence_considered: D30: SMOKE -> [RESOURCE GATE(S) if required] -> FULL; RESOURCE gate count/rationale is a per-task judgment recorded before FULL
T07 FULL already proved src/lightgbm_baseline.fit_binary_classifier at full scale (9,785,714 rows, ~29 min, no OOM) with the identical frozen config
T-Learner's two arm-specific fits are each on populations smaller than T07's already-proven scale (8,317,858 treated, 1,467,856 control)
docs/05_methodology_scope.md: cross-fitting is NOT required for T-Learner (unlike X-Learner/DR-Learner), so no new computational pattern is introduced
docs/05_methodology_scope.md T-Learner section: 'the same base-learner family and frozen configuration for both surfaces' -- prescriptive, not just a default

T05 frozen (T,Y) support (train_support.json/validation_support.json): the binding smoke-support constraint is the control-arm converter cell (T=0,Y=1), rarer in validation-relative-allocation than in train-relative-allocation because validation is only ~17.65% of any proportional draw
decision_record.decision: SMOKE -> FULL. resource_gates = 0. smoke_size = 200000 total development rows (train+validation combined, joint-(T,Y)-stratified, seed 42), a T08-local reproducibility/config value, not inherited from T07's smoke_size and not a global constant.
decision_record.why_200000_not_100000: At 100,000, the binding cell (validation T=0,Y=1, the control arm's early-stopping eval set positive class) allocates to only ~5 rows -- too thin to reliably exercise mu0's early-stopping/serialization code path on non-degenerate binary structure. At 200,000, the same cell allocates to ~10, giving meaningful headroom while remaining clearly bounded/development-only (well under FULL's 11,882,652-row scale).
decision_record.why_not_resource_gate: The resource-risk trigger in D30 is not met: the fitting mechanism is already proven at full scale by T07, T-Learner's per-arm populations are each smaller than what's already proven, and T-Learner has no cross-fitting or other qualitatively new computational pattern. Running two sequential fits instead of one is additive wall-clock, not a new resource-risk category.
decision_record.smoke_purpose: Engineering/correctness rehearsal only -- proves both arm-specific fits execute on genuinely non-degenerate (both-outcome-class) data, full artifact/reload/hash mechanics work, and tau construction/alignment/sign logic works. It is not a performance estimate and must not be treated as one. If any required arm/outcome cell is degenerate (empty) at the actual allocated counts, SMOKE fails closed rather than the sample being adjusted after seeing model results.

scale_gating.smoke_selection_rule: one deterministic joint-(T,Y)-stratified train_test_split draw per partition (train, validation), quota-proportional to the frozen train:validation split sizes, seed 42; held-out never sampled or read; no model score or metric enters selection

lightgbm.tuning: none -- one predeclared configuration, reused unchanged from T07, for both arm surfaces

preprocessing.transform_fit_scope: LightGBMFeatureTransform (T04 v2, D32) fit ONCE on the full/smoke train partition (not per-arm); arm-subsetting happens on the already-transformed X/y/T via boolean masks. Continuous features (f0/f2/f7/f10) stay float64; categorical features (f1/f3/f4/f5/f6/f8/f9/f11) become the train-fitted pandas categorical representation LightGBM recognizes natively. No new preprocessing semantics invented beyond D32's feature-type correction.
